capabilities.phased-request-transform: Two ordered request transforms with different visibility, plus restoration of prompt and tool state between them.
capabilities.provider-payload-hook: A hook over the assembled provider request body, distinct from the model messages.
capabilities.provider-header-hook: A hook that can read and mutate outgoing provider headers.
capabilities.provider-response-observe: Observation at the point status and headers arrive, before the stream is consumed.
capabilities.streaming-channel: Bounded per-event delivery for streamed deltas, with ordering and backpressure rules.
capabilities.message-rewrite: Rewriting a finalized message of any role before it is committed.
capabilities.settlement-entry-write: Appending arbitrary entries and forcing another request at the settlement boundary.
capabilities.compaction-result-fidelity: A compaction hook that returns a kept-entry boundary, details, and usage, not only a summary string.
